notes: Market prep: weekdays at 10:00 (Settings 'prep_time') or 'prep me for the session': each pair's trend, key levels, overnight move and news, drawn on a panel, with a short spoken brief. Trading twin: 'learn my trading' finds which setups you win with from your own journal; Jarvis nudges you when one forms (no AI, every 5-minute close). Crews: encrypted shared memory with friends' Jarvises; 'make a crew called Friday D&D' gives a code, and only people with it can join, read or add notes.
